subject.title: fix(memory): rank filename and path matches

question: Should the path-FTS table constant and trigger lifecycle helpers become supported public Plugin SDK exports, or should memory-core access them through a narrower non-public host seam?
rationale: The extension boundary prevents memory-core from importing host internals, while Plugin SDK policy makes new exports long-lived compatibility obligations; automation cannot choose the permanent ownership boundary.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Expose one narrower host operation or move publication ownership so third-party plugins do not receive raw trigger-management helpers.

options.title: Accept public SDK exports
options.body: Keep the three exports, update the pinned SDK surface contract, and explicitly own them as supported plugin API.

recommendation.title: Keep lifecycle internal
recommendation.body: Expose one narrower host operation or move publication ownership so third-party plugins do not receive raw trigger-management helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the memory plugin/SDK boundary and authored the rewrite that created this API-ownership choice.
